about: Off-grid communications projects made or used in Indiana. Submitted through the 'Add a project' issue form; name, description, license, and last update come from each project's own page and are refreshed weekly by tools/projects.py. Listing is not endorsement. An optional image is the project's own logo or a maker's photo, kept as a small file in assets/projects/; never a personal account's avatar.
